entities.summary: Nikolaos "Nikos" Chatzis is a retired Greek professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 1.96 m tall, he played at the shooting guard position. He is among the all-time leaders in the history of the Greek Basket League in points scored, assists, 3 pointers made, and games played.
